Merc Groups and each country's
Development Level affect each other.

rows.label: tlk43420341_04_msg0002
rows.name:
Raising a country's Development
Level will create new business
opportunities.

rows.label: tlk43420341_04_msg0003

countries and create new products.

rows.label: tlk43420341_04_msg0004

In turn, work for mercenaries
will increase...

rows.label: tlk43420341_04_msg0005
rows.name:
And completing those missions helps
the country develop again.

rows.label: tlk43420341_04_msg0006

The Hræsvelgr Mercenaries
that Vandham built up are
now your responsibility.
